description: This file defines the 'Directory' class within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace, implementing directory traversal, sorting, and management of child entries, specifically for use in a documentation or content tree structure.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory node in a content tree, capable of managing child entries, sorting, and providing access to index and first page information.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts child entries into buckets based on naming conventions and sorts them accordingly.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of child entries.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a new child entry to the directory.

methods.name: removeChild
methods.description: Removes a specified child entry from the directory.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration object associated with this directory's root.

methods.name: getLocalIndexPage
methods.description: Returns the local index page if it exists.

methods.name: getIndexPage
methods.description: Retrieves the index page, inheriting from parent if necessary.

methods.name: seekFirstPage
methods.description: Recursively searches descendants for the first available page.

methods.name: getFirstPage
methods.description: Returns the first page found within the directory or its descendants.

methods.name: setFirstPage
methods.description: Sets the first page in the directory.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Determines if the directory or its descendants contain any content.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a nested array representing the directory structure for debugging.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a child entry exists at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a child entry by offset.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a child entry at a given offset.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes a child entry at a given offset.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over child entries.
